title: Golub Capital BDC Reports Fiscal Q4 Earnings, NII $0.32 Per Share
summary: Golub Capital BDC reported net investment income of $0.32 per share for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and declared a $0.33 per share distribution.
body_markdown:
GAAP net income was $20.1 million, or $0.08 per share, compared with earnings per share of $0.22 for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The quarter included a net realized and unrealized loss of $0.24 per share. The company said the adjusted loss was primarily due to unrealized depreciation on certain portfolio companies on or taken to non-accrual and on equity investments in previously restructured companies, partially offset by net realized gains on equity exits.


Net asset value per share decreased to $14.00 at September 30, 2026, from $14.25 at June 30, 2026. On Thursday, November 12, 2026, the board declared the quarterly distribution of $0.33 per share, payable on Wednesday, December 30, 2026, to stockholders of record as of Monday, December 14, 2026.


## Why It Matters for GBDC


Total investments at fair value were $7,799.2 million across 432 portfolio companies at September 30, 2026, compared with $8,196.4 million across 424 portfolio companies at June 30, 2026. According to the company's[earnings presentation](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1476765/000147676526000084/gbdcfy2026q4epfinal.htm) , new investment commitments were $20.0 million in the quarter, and the company said it continued to prioritize share repurchases over new investment commitments. The company noted that quarterly comparisons of net income may not be meaningful.
